user_question: I am ordering full-price cookware through a participating store on April 12. Its merchandise subtotal is $82 after item-level discounts, before tax and shipping. Can I use the voucher?
campaign_terms: Spring Table Event: The voucher is valid from April 1 through April 30, 2026, on full-price cookware and tableware purchased through participating stores. The merchandise subtotal must be at least $75 after item-level discounts and before tax and shipping. Clearance items and gift cards are excluded. The voucher cannot be combined with other promotional offers.
